openCheckin: Open check-in to update your condition
earlySignalCallReason: Early Signals detected a concern needing prompt attention. Select your current condition on screen. Reporting that you are okay does not automatically dismiss this alert.
interactionHint: Listen to the guidance and select a button on screen. This call does not record your spoken answer.
responseCountdown: {{seconds}} seconds left to respond. Contacting continues until confirmation.
responseDeadline: The response window has ended. Updating the next contact step.
emergencyNote: In an emergency, call 115 now. Do not wait for a relative to confirm in the app.
phoneUnavailable: Could not open the phone app on this device.
timeUnavailable: Server time is not available yet
schedulePreview: If you have not checked in, Asinu starts contacting at {{time}} ({{timezone}}){{nextDay}}.
noEligibleContacts: No relative currently has alert and confirmation permissions with a registered notification device. The schedule cannot be enabled yet.
contactSetupHint: You can still adjust your settings. To enable the schedule, connect at least one relative, grant alert and confirmation permissions, and ask them to enable notifications in Asinu.
manageCareCircle: Set up relatives in Care Circle
urgentSettingsNotice: Urgent alerts contact relatives simultaneously for up to 30 minutes. Picking up does not stop other calls; select I will check on them. After accepting an urgent call, you have up to 2 minutes to confirm.
title: Check-in calls
subtitle: Asinu will call if you have not checked in after the allowed time.

homeControl.title: Check-in reminder calls
homeControl.offSummary: Automatic check-in reminder calls are off. You can still check in manually in the app.
homeControl.onBody: Asinu will call when you miss a check-in according to your saved schedule. If you do not respond, Asinu continues contacting eligible relatives in your Care Circle.
homeControl.offBody: Asinu will not start automatic check-in reminder calls on your schedule. Alerts and calls already in progress will continue; turning the schedule off does not confirm that you are safe. You can still check in manually in the app.
homeControl.updateFailed: Could not update the call status. Please try again.

editSettingHint: Tap to show decrease and increase controls.
settingsNotice: Feeling slightly unwell: call family members one at a time. Urgent support: call everyone in the Care Circle. Family members must enable notifications and have permission to receive alerts. Disabling this feature only cancels schedules that have not started; active alerts will continue.
accessRequiredTitle: You cannot configure this feature yet
accessRequiredBody: Check-in calls are included with An Tam. Upgrade to enable call schedules and configure how Asinu contacts your family.
profileGalleryAccessibility: Open the check-in call interface gallery

contact.callPerson: Call the person to check on
contact.unavailable: Could not load the person to check on.

statusAcceptFailed: Could not accept the call. The response buttons are still available.
statusUserMild: Started contacting family: feeling slightly unwell.
statusFamilyConfirmed: We recorded that you will take action. This does not confirm that your family member is safe.
statusFamilyUnavailable: No relative has confirmed they will check yet.
statusConnectionLost: The call connection was lost; the response buttons are still available.

triage.urgentNow: I need immediate help, alert my family
triage.skipDetails: Skip details, report that I am unwell

triage.urgentAccessibilityHint: Selecting this sends an urgent alert to every family member.
triage.locationInstruction: Choose the part of your body that feels most uncomfortable.
triage.symptomInstruction: Choose the closest description for the area you selected.
triage.intensityInstruction: Choose the closest level. Asinu will still notify your family after this step.
triage.intensityMildDesc: You are alert and can still manage normal activities.
triage.intensityModerateDesc: A family member should contact and check on you soon.
triage.intensityUrgentDesc: Breathing difficulty, a fall, fainting, or unable to manage alone.

playback.errorHint: You can still read the message and respond now, or try replaying it.

safetyNote: Asinu provides reminders and notifications only. It is not an emergency response or diagnostic service.

result.statusUserUnreachableMessage: Asinu has not recorded that you are okay and has started contacting family. You can still open check-in to update your condition.
result.statusFamilyHandledMessage: A relative confirmed they will check. Asinu stops contacting others, but this does not confirm that you are safe.
result.statusCheckinRecordedMessage: The missed check-in call has stopped. Any urgent alert is still handled separately.
result.statusCancelledMessage: This call is no longer active. Cancellation does not confirm that your health is okay.
result.userOkTitle: We recorded that you are okay
result.userOkMessage: Today's check-in is complete. Asinu will not contact your family.
result.mildTitle: We recorded that you feel slightly unwell
result.mildMessage: Asinu has started contacting your family members one at a time.
result.urgentMessage: Asinu is contacting all eligible family members at the same time.
result.familyConfirmedMessage: Asinu recorded that you will check on them. This does not confirm that your family member is safe.
result.familyUnavailableMessage: No family member has accepted the alert. Please contact a relative directly and review your Care Circle.
result.expiredMessage: No response was selected before the timeout. The system did not record that you are okay.

audio.userPrompt: Please select an option on the Asinu screen: I am okay, I feel slightly unwell, or I need help now.
audio.triagePrompt: Please quickly describe how you feel. Choose mild fatigue or dizziness, pain or discomfort, or immediate help.
audio.triageLocationPrompt: Choose the part of your body that feels most uncomfortable.
audio.triageSymptomPrompt: Choose the closest description of what you feel.
audio.triageIntensityPrompt: Choose how severe it feels now. If you have trouble breathing, have fallen, fainted, or need immediate help, choose help now.
audio.userOk: Asinu recorded that you are okay. Thank you.
audio.userMild: Asinu recorded that you feel slightly unwell and will notify your family.
audio.userUrgent: Asinu recorded an urgent situation and is contacting your family.
audio.userRetry: Asinu did not receive your choice. Please open Asinu and tap the option that matches how you feel on screen.
audio.familyMild: Asinu reports that your family member feels slightly unwell. Please choose I will check on them.
audio.familyUrgent: Asinu has an urgent support alert. Please review the details on screen and select I will check on them to confirm that you will help your family member.
audio.familyUnknown: Asinu could not reach the user. Please choose I will check on them.
